verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration REST API, but nothing in the evidence shows the API itself is versioned or that a deprecation policy exists. Product release tags (26.7.x) and a rolling-update compatibility check are adjacent features, not API versioning or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
